outcome: Obstetric outcomes (e.g., miscarriage, preterm birth, mode of delivery)
Infant anthropometric measurements (weight, length, occipito-frontal circumference)
cohort: 96 pregnant women with epilepsy (WWE) and 53 age and sex matched infants not exposed to AEDs
finding: The study found that while the rate of congenital abnormalities was comparable between infants exposed to AEDs in utero and those unexposed, AED exposure was associated with growth retardation in infancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were not increased in women with epilepsy.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in infants exposed to AEDs
